proof:
import Split
import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Finite

open DiffusionSplit

theorem DiffusionSplit.endpoint_count (A : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) (t : ℕ) (x : ℤ × ℤ) :
    Nat.card {w : Word // w.sum = x ∧ w.length = t ∧ ∀ a ∈ w, a ∈ A} =
    Nat.card {uv : Word × Word // FirstArrival x uv.1 ∧ uv.2.sum = 0 ∧
      uv.1.length + uv.2.length = t ∧ ∀ a ∈ uv.1 ++ uv.2, a ∈ A} := by
  apply Nat.card_congr
  first | (apply Equiv.symm; exact?) | exact?
